requests.scope: Stops at first actual token difference; no tolerance or near-tie acceptance. No HTTP trajectory identity is inferred. compared_full_state_batched_identity replays legacy-batched accepted pairs as one 2-token batch against the verifier's batch arithmetic; a false there is a real batch-vs-batch defect, while a false compared_full_state_identity with a true batched control is inherent batch-vs-singleton rounding.
